# imgagent
> The image acquisition agent for AI agents and pipelines: search → normalize → rank → dedupe → download → verify → manifest. One command, one JSON contract, verified bytes. MIT licensed, runs headless, no paid APIs required.

The image acquisition agent for autonomous software. Discovers, ranks, downloads and verifies images from public sources (Wikimedia Commons, Openverse, DuckDuckGo, any URL, custom JSON APIs) and delivers a machine-readable manifest with SHA-256 hashes, dimensions, provenance and rights status. Deterministic, idempotent, security-hardened. Install: `pip install imgagent`. PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/imgagent/

- [AGENTS.md — complete operating manual for AI agents](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent/blob/main/AGENTS.md): golden rules, command map, failure taxonomy, anti-patterns. Also at runtime: `imgagent agent-instructions`.
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent/blob/main/docs/CLI_REFERENCE.md): every command, flag, exit code.
- [API reference](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent/blob/main/docs/API_REFERENCE.md): programmatic surface (search_images, run_image_job, get_manifest, …).
- [Provider matrix](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent/blob/main/docs/PROVIDERS.md): supported sources, auth, rate limits, tested dates.
- [Integration guide](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent/blob/main/docs/INTEGRATION.md): manifest contract for renderers (Opuscar) and pipelines.
- [Security model](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): SSRF guards, redirect validation, verification pipeline.
- [Cookbook](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent/blob/main/docs/COOKBOOK.md): copy-runnable agent recipes (scene fill, batch, CI).
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Bilal140202/imgagent)
- [Landing page](https://superz1402.github.io/imgagent-site/)

## Example: one-command rights-cleared acquisition
```bash
imgagent run "Isdal Woman Norway 1970" --require-reuse-rights --top 8 \
  --project isdal --scene scene-04 --out ./assets --json
```
stdout: exactly one JSON object (`imgagent.result/v1`); deliverable: `manifest_path` → `imgagent.manifest/v1` with verified local paths, sha256, provenance, rights_status. Exit codes: 0 success/partial, 1 no results, 2 bad usage, 3 config problem.
